Credit exam

CLEP examinations

Current offer. Demonstrate existing knowledge or prepare independently across general education and business subjects.

Research profile · confirm exact school and course acceptance

How the credit works

College Board examinations with exam-specific ACE recommendations; each institution sets scores, awards and applicability.

Pace and learning format

Preparation is self-directed; exam length and appointment availability vary by subject and delivery method.

Costs to check

Official current pages display a $97 exam fee. Remote proctoring adds $30; testing-center charges vary. Eligible Modern States or military funding may change net cost.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Proctored at a test center or remotely where eligible. Remote delivery has age, location, equipment and room requirements.

Before you commit

  • Choose the exact receiving school, degree, and catalog year.
  • Confirm this specific course, recommendation or transcript source—not only the provider’s name.
  • Ask which requirement the learning will satisfy and check duplicate-credit, grade, date, and source limits.
  • Keep a written school decision before paying for an outside course you need for graduation.
